name: Broken Hill Solar Plant
notable: 74 MW solar farm at Broken Hill, NSW. Developed by AGL Energy. Co-located in the same area as the Broken Hill BESS. One of the earliest large-scale solar plants in far western NSW.

timeline.title: EPBC Referral 2012/6621
timeline.detail: Broken Hill Solar Plant, NSW — Not Controlled Action

timeline.title: Commercial operations commenced
timeline.detail: Commencement date from AEMO registration via OpenElectricity.

timeline.title: First generation recorded
timeline.detail: First market dispatch data recorded in AEMO systems.

eis_specs.document_title: AGL Broken Hill Solar Plant Environmental Assessment (Part 3A) – Volume 5 (of the EA)
eis_specs.connection_substation_name: Broken Hill 220 kV substation (TransGrid), on the western periphery of Broken Hill
eis_specs.connection_distance_note: ~2.7 km double-circuit overhead line (22 kV cabling on 220 kV structures per EA) from plant to TransGrid Broken Hill substation, 30 m easement
eis_specs.notes: Developer AGL Energy with First Solar EPC; ARENA + NSW Government co-funded (Solar Flagships). 53 MWac on ~140 ha, 5 km SW of Broken Hill. Fixed-tilt First Solar CdTe thin-film modules. Approved under Part 3A on 27 Mar 2013 (s75J EP&A Act); commissioned Jan 2016. Co-located with the AGL Broken Hill BESS (from mid-2020s).
